column2: Ports translated from machine code gained checks that end a mutated check where it reads a register nothing set, and three fixes to the order of float operands changed 24 more. Real calls run as before, but 222 ports changed, so 4,146 blocks verified on the old ones stopped counting. f1's runs verified 2,641, and by f2, 2,936 of the 4,146 were verified again.

A fix to how ported code carries registers through calls regenerated 384 ports, so earlier results on them stopped counting. Rerunning those jobs verified all but 207 of their blocks again. The 207 had come from mutated checks, probes and fuzzing, which an exact rerun doesn't repeat. Nothing was found wrong with them.
